name: Haramase Shokushu Otoko♂ OL - Mahou Shoujo to no Jupujupu Seikatsu
original_name: 孕ませ触手男♂ OL・魔法少女とのじゅぷじゅぷ生活
source:
"Tentacles aren't a handicap! They're a virtue!!"
Ichiro Suzuki is a tentacled salary man.
One night he gets touchy with his 30s-something boss.
Her hot hot body makes his wiggly squiggly bits throb.
Then there's the time he throws down with a virtuous magical girl.
Seize the pink future with all your limbs, Ichiro!

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ114686.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
“触手不是累赘，而是美德！！”

铃木一郎是一名长着触手的上班族。某天夜里，他对三十多岁的女上司动手动脚。她火辣的身体让他那扭动的触手兴奋不已。之后，他还和一位贞洁的魔法少女一决高下。用你所有的触手抓住粉色未来吧，一郎！[引自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ114686.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
